chapter.heading: A psalm of Asaph.
chapter.v:
Truly God
is good to Israel, to those whose minds are pure.

But I
was stumbling, my feet were starting to slide,

because I
was jealous of self-important people—I saw how well the wicked were doing.

They don't
ever seem to get sick; they are strong and healthy.

They don't
have problems like other people; they don't get hit by disasters like everybody else.

They wear
their pride like a necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

Their eyes
bulge out because they're so fat; their minds are full of selfish vanity.

They mock
people, and speak maliciously; they arrogantly threaten cruelty.

They talk
irreverently against heaven above, and defame people here on earth.

As a
result people turn to them and drink in everything they say.

“God won't
find out,” they say. “The Most High doesn't even know what's going on!”

Look at
these wicked people! They don't have a care in the world, and they're always making money!

It's been
pointless to keep my mind pure and my hands clean.

I'm cursed
with suffering all day long; every morning I'm punished.

If I'd
talked like this to others, I would have betrayed your people.

So I
thought about it and tried to understand, but it looked like a lot of hard work to me—

until I
went into God's Temple. Then I understood what happens to the wicked in the end.

For you
send them on a slippery path; you throw them down to destruction.

How quickly
they're destroyed! They come to a terrifying end.

Like waking
up from a dream, Lord—when you get up you will forget all about them!

At that
time my thoughts were bitter. I felt like I had been stabbed.

I was
stupid and ignorant. I was like a brute beast to you.

Yet I'm
always with you; you hold me by the hand.

You tell
me what to do; and ultimately you will welcome me in glory.

Who is
there in heaven for me except you? And I want nothing on earth except you.

My body
and my mind may fail, but God is the foundation of my life. He is mine forever!

Those people
who are far from God will die. You destroy all those unfaithful to you.

But I
love to stay close to God! I have chosen the Lord God to protect me. I will share all that you have done.
